def go(wps, grip, dry=False):
    """wps: list of (t, pose); pre-compensate each waypoint by band in its joint-motion direction."""
    q_prev = np.array(ep.observe()["robot"]["q"]); cmds=[]; qts=[]
    for (t,p) in wps:

        q = np.array(ik["solutions"][0]["q"]); s = np.sign(q-q_prev)
        cmds.append(rh.waypoint(t, ep.fk(list(q+s*BAND))["tcp_pose"], grip)); qts.append(q); q_prev = q
